verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser has a dedicated captcha-solving docs page stating it can automatically detect and solve CAPTCHAs when enabled at session creation, which is a clear documented stance (automatic solving). Stealth and Ultra Stealth modes add anti-bot-detection support. The Cloudflare-block anecdote concerns bot blocking generally, not captcha solving, so it does not create a concrete dispute. Missing for 10: documented behavior when solving fails (error surfacing vs. silent failure), any human-in-the-loop fallback, depth on supported captcha types, independent or hands-on corroboration of solving.
